questions.question: Why Linux-first for this OS course?
options: fork, signals, /proc, and QEMU/GDB flows are Linux-native
questions.explanation: Later lessons use fork, /proc, strace, and ELF toolchains directly.

questions.question: verify.py exits 1. What does that mean?
options: At least one required tool missing from PATH
questions.explanation: Non-zero = missing tool, printed by name.

questions.question: What does -v "$PWD:/osfs" do?
options: Copies files into the image forever
Mounts your repo into the container live
questions.explanation: Mount = live mirror; edits appear instantly both sides.

questions.question: which -a gcc shows /mnt/c/... first. Risk?
options: make may invoke Windows gcc instead of Linux one
questions.explanation: First PATH entry wins; prefer /usr/bin or work in Docker.

questions.question: What belongs in a toolchain bug report?
options: OS, kernel, tool versions, door used (WSL vs Docker)
questions.explanation: The toolchain card makes repro one glance.

questions.question: --strict adds what?
questions.explanation: 32-bit boot sectors need the i386 emulator.
